title: F126.5.1 the guide's evals: the overview
caption: What F126.5.1 builds: a page given in the eval file, the guide's conversations from its rules and from the turn log, the injection case, and a baseline replayed free.

cards.title: F126.5.1 The guide's evals
cards.text: One conversation for each rule the guide keeps, and for each failure the turn log shows.

cards.title: A page given in the file
cards.text: A conversation's page as content, sent as a visitor's message carries one (2).

cards.title: From its rules
cards.text: Greets, short answers, no doc named, the part of the site, a walkthrough, cards, a lead that stops before the send (3).

cards.title: The injection case
cards.text: Hidden instructions on a given page, checked in code (4).

cards.title: From the turn log
cards.text: Failures the log shows without anyone's words (5).

cards.title: Baseline, replayed free
cards.text: One live run of three repeats, every first repeat kept and replayed (6, 7).
